sentences.text: The records contain 15 source reports dated 1952-04-22 to 2021-06-11 for a 71-year-old male.

Your records list active conditions including diabetes, hypertriglyceridemia, metabolic syndrome X, anemia, diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and macular edema and retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.

For blood sugar (glucose), the latest value was 100.2 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL. Over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11, blood sugar (glucose) went from 105.7 mg/dL to 109.1 mg/dL and then 100.2 mg/dL.

For HbA1c (average blood sugar over the last few months), the latest value was 7 % on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of 4-5.6 %. Over the last 3 reports between 2019-11-08 and 2021-06-11, HbA1c (average blood sugar over the last few months) stayed stable at 7 %, then 7 %, and then 7 %.

For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), the latest value was 153 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL. Over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11, LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol) went from 128.5 mg/dL to 126.3 mg/dL and then 153 mg/dL.

For SGPT (a liver enzyme), the latest value was 59.6 U/L on 2021-04-15, which is above the usual range of 7-40 U/L. Over the last 3 reports between 2019-04-16 and 2021-04-15, SGPT (a liver enzyme) went from 24.4 U/L to 34.7 U/L and then 59.6 U/L.

For total cholesterol, the latest value was 237.5 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL. Over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11, total cholesterol went from 213.7 mg/dL to 173.4 mg/dL and then 237.5 mg/dL.

For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), the latest value was 196.5 mg/dL on 2021-06-11, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL. Over the last 3 reports between 2020-06-05 and 2021-06-11, triglycerides (a type of blood fat) went from 187.6 mg/dL to 131.4 mg/dL and then 196.5 mg/dL.
Your other test results did not raise an alert.
The latest blood pressure reading was 110/84 on 2021-06-11, which is below 140/90.

Your ongoing medicines are Simvastatin 10 MG Oral Tablet, 120 ACTUAT Fluticasone propionate 0.044 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler, and NDA020503 200 ACTUAT Albuterol 0.09 MG/ACTUAT Metered Dose Inhaler.
No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You could discuss your recent blood sugar and HbA1c levels with your doctor.
You can ask your doctor about your cholesterol and triglyceride results.
You may also want to talk about your liver enzyme results.
